steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Use où est...? to ask where a place is. Listen for the landmark and direction. For a short plan, say je vais + verb; the second verb stays in its infinitive form.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Où est la station de métro ?
steps.tip: Say it: oo eh lah stah-SYOH(N) duh may-TROH

steps.en: How do I get to the museum?
steps.tip: Say it: koh-ma(n) ah-lay oh mü-ZAY

steps.fr: Continuez tout droit, s'il vous plaît.
steps.tip: Say it: kohn-tee-nü-AY too drwah seel voo pleh

steps.fr: Tournez à gauche au feu rouge.
steps.en: Turn left at the traffic light.
steps.tip: Say it: toor-NAY ah gohsh oh fuh roozh

steps.fr: Traversez la rue et tournez à droite.
steps.en: Cross the street and turn right.
steps.tip: Say it: trah-vehr-SAY lah rü ay toor-NAY ah drwaht

steps.en: I am going to take the metro.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh pra(n)dr luh may-TROH

steps.fr: Je vais descendre à la prochaine station.
steps.en: I am going to get off at the next station.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh day-SAH(N)dr ah lah proh-SHEN stah-SYOH(N)
Say it: oo eh lah-reh doh-toh-BÜS

steps.fr: Je voudrais un billet, s'il vous plaît.
steps.en: I would like a ticket, please.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh voo-DREH uh(n) bee-YAY seel voo pleh

steps.fr: Il y a un détour sur la ligne.
steps.en: There is a detour on the route.
steps.tip: Say it: eel yah uh(n) day-TOOR sür lah leen-yuh
